item: R111 step T2, slice 1: Feed card keywords, the article list's top keyword, the keyword-tags explorer, the link preview and the concept-map arms hide a stoplisted word at read time
summary: Five listings that never consulted the stoplist now go through the hidden predicate, so a word shipped with an update disappears from stored data with no recompute and no user step; the article list reports no top keyword when the stored one is stoplisted (the next best waits for the T3 recompute). Each test fails without the change. Bulletin coverage/stories/articles, the cached Home cards, omnibar and did-you-mean remain.
